incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: checkout service spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in the 19:37:20–19:42:20 window carry status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with otel.status_description/exception.message 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.type 13; the failing trace ids shown are e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985, b29c72754beaa01ed0745f7e6f8d4db9 and 6816741e6eb799f4a30cbe769d1bebe6 (durations 44443 us, 25016 us, 9803 us), while other PlaceOrder spans in the same sample carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (e.g. 53523 us in trace 5f28281cb5c1a6c188dadd30bc05cc62, 28207 us in trace c8222a73e8c0bb9178c67b0b17eda787).

checkout's client call span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service checkout) is the failing dependency call: status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2, otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', durations 10435 us / 4066 us / 3360 us, parented to the failing PlaceOrder spans in traces e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985, b29c72754beaa01ed0745f7e6f8d4db9 and 6816741e6eb799f4a30cbe769d1bebe6.

The payment service's own server spans are the deepest failing identity: service=payment operation 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' spans with error=true and otel.status_code=ERROR in traces e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985, b29c72754beaa01ed0745f7e6f8d4db9 and 6816741e6eb799f4a30cbe769d1bebe6, carrying grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) ... at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'. Other payment Charge server spans in the same sample (traces 5f28281cb5c1a6c188dadd30bc05cc62, c8222a73e8c0bb9178c67b0b17eda787, 04e1f9ace656c28b3980bd156d493f19) are rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Within payment's Charge server span in trace e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985 there is a child span 'grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat' with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (4257 us), i.e. a feature-flag evaluation completed without error; the flag value returned is not visible in the span tags shown.

cart's own spans in this window show no errors: span_groups lists POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem (2 rows), POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (4), HGET (6), HMSET (2), EXPIRE (2), all status not_recorded, error_rows 0, max duration 2738 us; checkout's client spans oteldemo.CartService/GetCart/EmptyCart are rpc.grpc.status_code=0.
currency's own spans show no errors: 'Currency/Convert' rows with otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 only, durations 269–2800 us in the rows shown.

shipping's own spans show no errors: oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and POST spans with http.status_code 200, durations 50–12730 us in the rows shown.

product-catalog's own spans show no errors: four oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, durations 73–223 us, and checkout's client span for the same operation is rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (991 us).

email shows no failures: POST /send_order_confirmation spans carry http.status_code 200 (14962 us, 10623 us, 5713 us) with child send_email and sinatra.render_template spans having no status tags, in the successful traces 04e1f9ace656c28b3980bd156d493f19, 5f28281cb5c1a6c188dadd30bc05cc62 and c8222a73e8c0bb9178c67b0b17eda787; no email span appears in the three traces that failed at payment.

frontend and frontend-proxy show their own 500 errors tied to this cause: in trace b29c72754beaa01ed0745f7e6f8d4db9, load-generator POST (33464 us), frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress, and frontend POST /api/checkout (29081 us, http.status_code 500) plus 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' carry error=true, http.status_code 500, otel.status_code=ERROR with exception.message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; in trace e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985 frontend POST /api/checkout is 56103 us with http.status_code 500.

The same payment failure is not new to the 19:37–19:42 window: in the earlier 19:30:00–19:35:00 window, checkout PlaceOrder spans already carry rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and matching payment client spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=2, across six distinct failing trace ids: 272fcccb884e8ba95af95c1039d8e065 (14701 us), 486c8b61cc911ee1bda647b10161cfed (14463 us), 6ca691f451b5eb25ce37badffb001fd0 (12120 us), d2ee2fa01a77bc612dc3b2c8ed19364e (8597 us), d911a67e1320b590c91d98901b12337f (8597 us), e4c58087303cc409fb52da511f7a38e4 (5279 us).

Most likely cause of the checkout errors: the payment service's Charge handler rejects a subset of charge requests locally (charge.js:37), throwing 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' with the request attribute app.loyalty.level=gold, which checkout surfaces unchanged as gRPC 13 and frontend surfaces as HTTP 500. Whether the rejection is driven by an injected feature-flag/fault behaviour, by a card-token validation rule, or by the non-secret request attributes is unknown: the flagd ResolveFloat child span completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 but its returned value is not visible, and no configuration or change history is integrated in this Run.

Rejected: a fault in checkout's own logic or in its other dependency calls (cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog, email) as the origin of the PlaceOrder failures. Those services' own client/server spans in the sampled traces are error-free (rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / http.status_code=200) and checkout's only error is the payment Charge call it propagates, so the error text originates in payment, not in checkout.

Possible latency elevation, not established: sampled checkout PlaceOrder durations are larger in 19:37–19:42 (error spans 9803–44443 us; successful spans 28207–53275 us) than the error PlaceOrder spans observed in the comparable earlier 19:30–19:35 window (5279–14701 us), and dependency spans stay in the 0.05–15 ms range (shipping GetQuote up to 12730 us, email confirmation up to 14962 us). The trace views are explicitly biased samples with no histogram data available, so no latency trend is asserted; if real, the added time sits in checkout/payment rather than in the sampled dependency calls.

gaps: Prometheus (target m0-otel-20260909) was unavailable for every metrics query in this Run: metrics_range_query on traces_span_metrics_calls_total (checkout, payment, unfiltered), app_payment_transactions_total and up{}, plus get_metric_names and get_label_values all returned status=error reason=SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no error-rate, no error ratio, no request-count and no latency-histogram or baseline comparison exists; the 'elevated errors' magnitude is unmeasured and missing series are unknown, not zero.

No pre-incident metrics baseline exists to quantify whether errors increased, so the observed 19:30–19:35 failures leave open how long the payment 'Invalid token' failure has been occurring and whether any rate change happened.

Trace coverage is a biased sample (8 checkout traces / 234 spans and smaller slices, with rows omitted), so the number of failing versus successful checkouts per minute, and the completeness of checkout's call graph (e.g. all payment, email and other calls), remain unknown.
Kubernetes state, pod logs and change history are not integrated in this Run, so payment's deployment/configuration state, restarts or flag/feature-flag changes cannot be checked.
next_steps: Have a human query Prometheus for traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment",span_name="grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge",status_code="ERROR"} and traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout",status_code="ERROR"} over several hours to measure the error ratio and its onset.

Have a human inspect rpc_client_duration_milliseconds / rpc_server_duration_milliseconds histograms for checkout->payment and checkout PlaceOrder to test the latency observation with a real baseline before treating it as a regression.

Have a human review payment's /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 charge path and any flagd flag value it evaluates (flag key and value are not visible in the sampled span) to determine whether 'Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' is an injected fault or a request-validation rule.
Confirm whether the same failing requests carry a specific synthetic user/card token, and whether only certain loyalty levels are affected, before planning any mitigation.
report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T19:37:20Z onwards) checkout's PlaceOrder spans fail with gRPC code 13 and the message 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (traces e92d9b838fdcfb6708df0bd6ccd86985, b29c72754beaa01ed0745f7e6f8d4db9, 6816741e6eb799f4a30cbe769d1bebe6). The deepest evidence is inside the payment service itself: its own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server spans are ERROR with a stack trace at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13), i.e. the charge handler throws locally and checkout merely propagates it. Checkout's other dependency calls visible in the sample — cart (GetCart/EmptyCart), currency (Convert), shipping (GetQuote/ShipOrder), product-catalog (GetProduct) and email (POST /send_order_confirmation) — show no error status; the successful traces carry http 200 email confirmations. However, the identical payment 'Invalid token' failure also appears in an earlier 19:30–19:35 window (6 distinct failing checkout traces), so the failure is not new to the last 5 minutes, and Prometheus was unavailable for every metrics query, so the reported 'elevated' magnitude (error ratio, latency histograms) could not be measured in this Run.
